name: portfoliospace
description: PortfolioSpace - a creative portfolio web app (React, Node, MongoDB, S3/MinIO, microservices)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
